mods.name: night-owl
mods.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

mods.name: personal-bests
mods.description: Tracks your records across sessions (longest session, most tool calls in a session, most files edited in a day, cheapest session over 30 minutes), toasts a new one, and lists them with /bests.
